profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I've worked 17+ years in the software industry at multiple technology startups and hedge funds in the greater Los Angeles area.  I have extensive experience in multiple software languages and development environments as a full-stack developer in building products, with deep expertise in data modeling, database scaling and optimization, systems architecture, and financial risk management algorithm development.  

I'm active in the software community of Southern California, including mentoring software engineers at various organization across the region.  I hold a BS in Computer Science from the University of Southern California

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Backend support for MySQL stored procedures and queries as well as database design.
•	Used PHP for business logic for various pages.
•	Set up a Solr Core to handle user queries on a Linux system.
•	Created stored procedures on a MySQL database to populate the Solr Cores.
•	Used JQuery to create front end that handles user searches.
•	Used PHP on the backend to handle user requests and send emails out
•	Used JQuery to create stats page to display user activity such as searches, geoip data and client

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Assisted in the development of a booking system written in C# using WPF and a SQL Server 2008 back end for daily use.   The system integrated with the Bloomberg API to get some relevant data on the security set up, then let the trader add/modify data for trading the security.  
•	Wrote extensive store procedures to help organized and display the booking information.
•	Created a process to get the booking data and allow our back office to review before sending it to custodian on a daily basis using FTP
•	Automated the daily morning and afternoon process using a C# console app to process various files we receive and update our database with the updated data as well as inform the relevant people if there were any discrepancies with the data.
•	Designed and implemented a WPF application that the users could use to input various pricing data for securities and display a comparison for a given date range to show the performance of all the input data relative to our current data.
•	Performed maintenance on various existing projects and procedures that were already in place
•	Installed and managed Redmine as a ticketing system to track all of  the development projects for our various systems

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Helped with the design and implementation the project that our customers used to view all the data we gathered for them.  The back end was in C# using VS2008 with .NET 3.5 and connected to a SQL Server 2008 database.  The front end was HTML with extensive use of JavaScript, JQuery and ASP.NET.  
•	Updated stored procedures as needed on SQL Server 2008 database for the above project.
•	Maintained a C# program that used SOAP to connect to our system then parsed out release data from rss feeds to keep our system updated on release dates of movies and TV episodes.
•	Created parsers in Ruby for various websites that used regex to parse out data from various formats of web pages and forums.  This allowed us to be able to identify and catalog relevant data for our customers as well as have the information needed to send notices to the sites if needed.
•	Designed and implemented a C++ Linux program in KDev a program that would automatically post many different web using JSON to get data from a web service and recorded responses.  This allowed us to post hundreds of notices per day as well as keep track of compliance levels.
•	Maintained and update multiple C++ projects and programs in a Linux (Fedora 13) environment.
•	Used Wireshark to help debug various network code.
•	Used SVN for version control.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Extensive work on a Linux C++ program for connecting to the Gnutella 2 network, including connecting to the network, processing packets, sending proper messages, properly uploading files to connected peers.
•	Worked on a team that used Linux in eclipse to write a C++ program that emulated the Gnutella Protocol including proper packet formatting, packet reading, compression of packets and  business logic in order to collect data from the network and do countermeasures.
•	Designed a C++ program under Linux a parser that would search bittorrent websites for content belonging to our clients.  The relevant results were stored in a MySQL database and use for countermeasures.
•	Programmed in Java a program for managing and processing data using a graphical front end as well as generating reports making use of extensive SQL calls for our data input team to be able to verify data and generate reports.
•	Designed and implemented a C++ program to scrape data from various web pages for data collection.
